newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sees over $10 bln in privatization receipts.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sees over $10 bln in privatization receipts.

text.p: The Brazilian government expects to exceed its original target for 1997 privatization receipts of 10 billion reais, said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir.
"The target was 10 billion reais and the expectatation is that this will be exceeded," Kandir told reporters.

Kandir said after a meeting of the National Privatization Council (CND) that revenue from privatizations between January and May already stood at 9.0 billion reais compared with 6.0 billion reais for the whole of 1996.

The jewel in the crown so far of Brazil's privatization program was the sale last month of a controlling stake in mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), which alone netted more than 3.0 billion reais.
On Wednesday, the Communications Ministry was due to announce qualifiers for bidding for concessions to run potentially lucrative Band B cellular telephone services.
The government expects to earn some 5.0 billion reais through those concessions.
